title: FinOps People Configuration
description: Defines household members and their default cost-sharing weights for shared (general) expenses.

currency.description: ISO 4217 3-letter currency code (e.g., BRL, USD, EUR).

id.description: Stable machine identifier for the person (e.g., person_a).

display_name.description: Human-friendly display name shown in the UI.

default_split_weight.description: Default share of general/shared expenses (weights across all people must sum to 1.0).
